# fix: dashboard - remove Parity source, FluffyLabs only

## Pull Request by @polykrate

## Summary
- Remove dual-source selector (Parity/FluffyLabs toggle) from dashboard
- Dashboard now fetches all data exclusively from FluffyLabs remote at runtime
- Fixes the issue where both sources displayed identical metrics (because the build pipeline overwrote the static Parity data with FluffyLabs data)
- Removes cross-source radar comparison logic and related components

## Changes
- `use-data-source.ts`: Simplified to only fetch FluffyLabs data, removed static Parity imports
- `page.tsx`: Removed `DataSourceSelector` and comparison props
- `STFRadarChart.tsx`: Removed cross-source comparison logic
- `DataSourceSelector.tsx`: Deleted

## Test plan
- [x] Build succeeds (`next build` passes)
- [x] Local dev server loads FluffyLabs data correctly
- [ ] Verify on deployment that metrics display correctly

Made with [Cursor](https://cursor.com)
